result_preview.title: Vendor Invoice Reconciliation Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously matches vendor invoices to POs and contracts, flags discrepancies for approval.
result_preview.description: This agent automatically reconciles incoming vendor invoices against purchase orders and master contracts using three-way matching logic. It validates line-item quantities, pricing, and terms; flags exceptions such as overbilling, duplicate invoices, or policy violations; and routes approved invoices for payment processing. This reduces manual touchpoints, accelerates cash flow, and minimizes payment disputes.
